The source unit code 'BT' is mapped through the built-in unit table to the canonical sell-unit enum; confirm the customer's canonical value for BT (e.g. BOTTLE) if their downstream system expects a different label.

notes: Table 0 is classified as products: one row per SKU with embedded price details, and SKU is the product identity key.
SKU values are zero-padded in the source (e.g. 00470001) even though profiling reports an integer type; preserve them as text.
Currency EUR and Sales unit BT are explicit in every row. BT should be handled through the built-in unit normalizer rather than remapped manually.
Tax included=No and Tax rate=5% are explicit row values, so vat_included=false and vat_rate=0.05 are supported by source evidence.
The 5% tax rate is synthetic fixture data and should not be treated as current tax advice.

tables.reason: One row per unique SKU with a matching unique product name, plus embedded sales-unit, currency and price attributes. It is the product master export rather than a standalone price list because it carries the required product identity and name.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header is SKU and all 12 values are unique product codes. Source cells are zero-padded (e.g. 00470001), so the identifier must be treated as text and preserve leading zeros despite the profiled int type.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header is Product name; 12 distinct non-null values, one per SKU, e.g. SIM neutral 1 through SIM neutral 12.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header is Currency and all 12 rows explicitly contain EUR. This is source evidence, not an inferred country-based currency.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header is Sales unit and all 12 rows contain the explicit unit code BT. This is a unit-of-measure field; the built-in unit normalizer knows BT as a bottle-style unit and should return the canonical sell-unit enum value.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header is Price list and all 12 rows explicitly state standard, satisfying the required price-list identity for the embedded /prices collection.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header is Net price and every row has a distinct positive monetary value from 1234.56 to 1356.77. Combined with the adjacent Tax included=No and Tax rate=5% columns, it is the price amount for the standard price list.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header explicitly asks whether tax is included and all 12 rows say No. This directly maps to vat_included=false; no VAT-inclusion convention is being inferred.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header is Tax rate and every row explicitly contains 5%. The source percentage must be converted to the numeric rate 0.05; this is fixture data, not a current tax recommendation.
